WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 'return'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales END) AS sales_before_returns,
  sum(CASE WHEN kind='return' THEN net_sales END) AS returns, sum(net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id=900 AS is_web_return_store, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ids,
 sum(CASE WHEN fs_store.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orig_web_lines
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store fs_store ON fs_store.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND (s.store_id=900 OR fs_store.store_id=900)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross_before, sum(r.returns_net) ret, sum(r.net_sales) net, count(*) days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
